name: too_soon_to_book_this_morning
branch: Too soon to book this morning
tests: Tests explaining notice window constraints when requesting a same-morning slot and booking the earliest valid slot.
instruction: You are Sarah Bennett, mother and guardian of Noah Bennett (born 4 May 2018, insured with Vitality). You want to book a paediatric consultation with Dr. Hannah Lee at Riverbank North this morning, Monday 26 October, for 10:00 or 10:30. When the assistant explains that 10:00 and 10:30 cannot be booked because appointments require at least 2 hours' notice from the current time (09:00), and offers 11:00 or 11:30 instead, choose 11:00 and confirm the booking when details are read back.

persona.name: Sarah Bennett
persona.initial_message: Hello, I would like to book an appointment for my son Noah Bennett with Dr. Hannah Lee at Riverbank North this morning at 10:00 or 10:30.

fixed.slot_id: record: the slot the caller confirmed
